title: The First Visual Pipeline Run, Including What Broke
description: Today the visual path actually runs: 7,610 unique images, 22,770 embeddings, an authoritative source, and two defects I repaired in use.
body:
A pipeline that has never been run is still a diagram. Today I have a measured collection. I am writing after the collector and the line from catalog to caption to vector, not ahead of them. I want the run, including what I had to repair, on the record while it is still in my hands.

Source of truth, then a model

Earlier this week I added a collection script that uses the index to gather a defined reference set rather than an accidental mixture of files. The same day I wrote a rumination on how visual records, entities, captions, and document evidence could stay connected without becoming one undifferentiated store, including a possible enterprise connector and a graph. That document is a rumination. I have not implemented it. I am not treating Alfresco or graph retrieval as built.

Today I make the DaVinci mirror on Z: the authoritative image source. The working copies remain. SHA-256 deduplication lets the stronger source win when the same picture exists in both. If I cannot say which copy is the original, I will caption the same evidence twice and call it knowledge.

I am also landing Phase 1 of the image pipeline: a controlled entity registry, associations from images to entities, and three live embedding layers from caption text — nouns, descriptive language, and the combined sentence. A fourth slot for CLIP is reserved. It is empty. Entity extraction on this date is tag alias matching against the registry, not a free-form reading of every caption.

The run, and the two defects

I scan 16,039 files and keep 7,610 unique images. I write 22,770 embeddings: three MiniLM vectors for each unique picture. That arithmetic excludes CLIP. I hit two defects in actual use. The caption catalog does not always carry a SHA-256 that the files table understands, so I have to compute file identity from source_path. pgvector returns vectors as text that I have to parse into numbers before they are usable. I repair both this evening. The numbers above are the run after those repairs, not a claim that the first attempt was clean.

This is testable behavior on this collection. It is not proof that visual evidence is now enterprise memory. It is not a narrative graph. It is not a live CLIP search. A later reader can still ask whether a result came from a noun, a mood, or a whole caption, and whether the picture is the DaVinci original or a working copy. That is a different kind of progress from a more fluent description of the same folder.

The entity registry is a controlled list — characters, themes, locations, moods, compositions — with aliases. Associations on this run are tag-based. A later POS pass over captions is described and not the thing that produced the 19,564 tag associations recorded with the run. If I mix those two methods in the telling, I make the outcome look cleaner than it was.

The next test

The next work is to use this path on a real retrieval task: from a question to a picture, through the source that won, the entity it was tagged with, and the layer that matched. Until that is done in anger, 22,770 embeddings are a successful run of a pipeline, not a claim that the collective can already see.

Historical basis: VALESKA commits 630d973 and e2a7341 (21 Feb), c4dfdb6, 03e0bed, e094f71, and 470e4cc (26 Feb). Counts (16,039 scanned, 7,610 unique, 22,770 embeddings) are from the contemporaneous operational record of that run. e2a7341 is architecture notes, not delivered connector or graph code.

data.author: David Gargan
data.coverAlt: Stone blocks of light on a terrace, with threads running from a catalog of books toward a river landscape: the first visual pipeline run, including the path that had to be repaired.
